text:
maya: Quick async for fleet — short status below (warmup/spillover in APAC).

maya: yesterday — tested the warmup orchestration for apac-west1, warmup jobs kicked but ~30% of warmup VMs never joined nodepool due to k8s taint scheduling. saw backlog in queue around 03:10 UTC.

ben: saw that spike in metrics. I manually nuked the taint on 3 nodes and they attached, backlog cleared in ~6m. :thumbsup:

maya: blocker — cloud quota bump for apac-west1 reservations is still pending with cloud support (ticket #CLOUD-1219). until that's approved we can't reliably reserve more capacity.

priya: update on quota ticket — cloud asked for billing owner confirmation, finance replied last night and cloud said ETA ~24h. pinged them again.

alex: small mitigation — I pushed a short-lived autoscaler tweak (threshold 0.55 -> 0.50) in staging; can promote to prod if folks agree. it reduces the chance of backlog but increases burst cost. open to opinions.

esther: I'm doing the canary rollout for model-x at 11:00 UTC; if autoscaler moves, let me know so I can pause.

maya: thanks. plan for today: 1) escalate quota with finance (done) 2) add a taint-guard check to warmup job (PR incoming) 3) coordinate with esther for canary timing.

ben: can help with the PR review and do a quick runbook update for manual taint fixes.

alex: I'll open the prod autoscaler PR but gate it behind a short-lived feature flag. link will follow.

priya: cloud replied to confirm receipt — moved ticket to high priority. will post updates in this thread when they respond.

infra-bot: [AUTO] spot eviction alert: apac-west1 region experienced 4 evictions between 03:05-03:20 UTC, affected nodepool-tilt-*.logs available in /var/logs/eviction/apac-west1/1764567.log

maya: small action items — @ben please add the taint workaround to runbook, @alex tag me on autoscaler PR, @priya paste quota ticket id here when it changes.

ben: will do. added preliminary runbook note.

alex: autoscaler PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/infra/auto/PR-432 — flagged.

priya: ticket updated: CLOUD-1219 -> CLOUD-1219A (escalated).

maya: cool — if cloud confirms within 24h we should be able to reserve +4 GPUs in apac-west1 for weekend tests. otherwise we'll continue with manual attach steps.

esther: noted, I'll delay the last canary wave by 30m just in case.

maya: thanks team. low-ceremony standup done — ping here with any new info.

ben: :eyes:

alex: :rocket:

infra-bot: [AUTO] scheduled maintenance in eu-west1 in 48h — may affect warmup scheduling if routing crosses regions.
